title: Potential risk factors for Ebstein anomaly, National Birth Defects Prevention Study, 1997-2011.
authors: Downing KF, Riehle-Colarusso T, Gilboa SM, Lin AE, Oster ME, Tinker SC, Farr SL, National Birth Defects Prevention Study.
quote: Ebstein anomaly was associated with maternal second-hand cigarette smoke exposure at home (odds ratio = 2.2 [95% confidence interval: 1.1, 4.4]), but not maternal cigarette smoking (odds ratio = 1.3 [95% confidence interval: 0.8, 2.1]).
